page.layout: One column of lexicon entries in Hebrew and Latin, set in roman and italic type, running from top to bottom. Below the last entry, at the right, the catchword. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: מָד[?] Mensus, Dimensus, Emensus est, Mensura-vit: Infinit. לְמַד[?] Ad mensurandum, Zach.2.6. Futur. תָּמוּד[?] Metieris, Ezech.45.3. Niph. Futur. יִמַּד[?] Mensurabitur, Hos.1.10. יִמָּדוּ[?] Mensurabuntur, Jer.31.37. Pih. Præter. וּמִדְּ־עֵרָב[?] Et (cor meum) emetitur vespe-ram, Job.7.4. sic enim R. Levi & Aben Esra subaudiunt Nomen לִבִּי. Futur. אֶמַּד[?] Metiar, Psal.60.8. וַיִּמַּד[?] Et mensus est, Hab.3.6. Hithp. Futur. וַיִּתְמַּד[?] Et mensus est se, 1.Reg.17.21.

מַד[?] m. Mensura: Aff. מִדָּתוֹ[?] Mensura ejus, Job.11.9. Plur. מִדֵּיהֶם[?] Mensurarum tuarum, Jerem.13.25. Est etiam Vestimentum, Vestis, quasi corporis Mensuram vel Mensuratum dicas, & semper cum Affixis invenitur: מִדּוֹ[?] Vestimento suo, Levit.6.10. כְּמִדּוֹ[?] Sicut vestimento suo, Psal.109.18. Plural. מְדָיו[?] Vestibus suis, 1.Sam.17.38. Et cum epenthefi ' loco literæ ' geminandæ; מְדֵיהֶם[?] Vestes eorum, 2.Sam.10.4.

מִדָּה[?] f. Mensura, Dimensio, Exod.26.2. אִישׁ מִדָּה[?] Vir mensuræ, 1.Paral.20.9. id est, Procerus. Constr. יְמֵי וּמִדַּת[?] Et mensuram dierum meorum, Psal.39.5. Item Tributum, ex usu Chaldaico: לְמִדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ[?] Pro tributo regis, Neh.5.4. Plural. אַנְשֵׁי מִדּוֹת[?] Viri mensurarum sunt, Num.13.33. id est, Procera statura: Aff. מִדּוֹתָיו[?] Vestium ejus, Psal.133.2. Et male. מִנַּת מִדְּיָךְ[?] Portio mensurarum tuarum, Jerem.13.v.25. Chald. מִדָּה[?] Tributum, quod à facultatibus suis quisque regi vel magistratui dat, quasi Demensum dictum: וּמִדָּה[?] Et tributum, Esr.4.20. Constr. מִדַּת[?] Esr.6.8. & Dagefch in ג refoluto, ut Chaldæis familiare, מִנְדָּה[?] Esr.4.13. & sic 7.24. Apud Talmudicos: לוֹ מוֹדִין[?] בְּמִדָּה שֶׁאָדָם מוֹדֵד[?] Quâ mensura homo mensus fuerit, remetiuntur ei: Sabbath fol.100.1. Confer Matth.7.2.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing and some dagesh marks are hard to make out at this scan resolution; all vocalised Hebrew forms are marked [?] and should be checked against the original. The large headword מָד and the Hebrew in the Talmudic line are uncertain. The catchword מרן is at the lower right. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
